summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Brera Holdings PLC reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held June 26, 2026. The filing details voting tallies on two resolutions: re-election of five board members and ratification of the independent auditor. Resolution 3 (appointment of statutory auditor) was adjourned for further candidate identification. There is no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a routine meeting report and does not constitute a special situation.
